title: Grok Bot Launches in Just One Month, Weekly Active Users Officially Exceed 400,000

content_html:
The competitive landscape in the field of artificial intelligence is facing new changes. According to the latest industry reports, the Grok Bot AI agent developed by Elon Musk's SpaceX AI team has successfully exceeded 400,000 weekly active users about a month after its launch.

The specific data performance is impressive. According to statistical data as of September 14, the user base of Grok Bot has rapidly increased to 418,000, achieving a strong 24% growth compared to the previous week. This growth rate not only confirms the popularity of this AI agent in the market but also demonstrates its rapid penetration and strong appeal among end-users.
